OzyVTT · polish · consistency sweep 3

Third sweep

What the first two sweeps left out, captured from every page of the 23 approved mockups at laptop and phone size: buttons, rows, the controls inside rows, empty states, steps rails, rolled numbers, boxes, the GM ONLY tag, colours, display titles, widths, numbers and dates, overlay edges and copy. 127 pages and 4343 captures, each measured from its computed style. An amber frame and number mark a capture that differs from its pattern or its rule; the findings say how, and what would bring it in line.

The CupBase lineGhostsDangerIcon buttonsPhone hit areasRowsControlsBoxesDisplay titlesStepsOverlaysColoursDatesEmpty statesGM ONLYWidthsCopyRolled numbersSweeps 1 and 2

What doesn't match

Twenty differences, most to least visible; the last two are in the rules more than the drawings. Tell me which fixes to make, by number.

1

Settings draws its groups as full boxes

I, settings; I, its leftovers; F, time and tools (the Codex's tools)

The theme's box is the Cradle: a base, sides that fade out before the top, no fill (T 2.4), and a box never holds another (rule 6). Settings, its leftovers and the Codex's tools draw every group as a 1 px box on all four sides with a fill, as I's own values ask, and the players at the table sit in a second box inside the Join address group. Every other area draws the Cradle.

Fix: Settings' groups become Cradles, each heading in the open top. The players' rows sit in their group divided by 1 px --line, with no box of their own. I's values table says Cradle.

2

Arrival's Cups carry an arrow

B, arrival; F, the Codex and finding and pages (the bar's New)

The Cup is words only (rule 2). Arrival's five Cups (Join as a player, Enter table, Set GM password, Play as Mirena, Prepare an encounter) end in an arrow icon. The Codex bar's New ends in a caret, which says it opens a menu of kinds (F rule 8).

Fix: Arrival's Cups lose the arrow. Rule 2 says a Cup that opens a menu keeps its caret.

3

Phone controls are drawn at laptop size

Every area with a phone

Every control keeps a 44 px hit area (T 2.5), A's phone header has two 44 px icons, and a sheet's close is a 44 px hit area (the shared parts' values). On the phones, 239 of the 301 different buttons and Cups are shorter than 44 px: Base line buttons 34 and 36 px, chips 28 to 32 px, icon buttons 36 px, the header's icons 40 px, a sheet's close 36 or 40 px, and 19 of 30 Cups 42 px. Nothing grows their hit area. The phone chips in the Codex, sound and time and tools, and arrival's buttons, are already 44 px.

Fix: On a phone every button, chip, icon button and Cup is at least 44 px tall, as those are; the header's icons and a sheet's close are 44 by 44. On a laptop a 36 px face keeps .tap-target. Rule 2.5 says so.

4

Danger is drawn four ways

I, settings; I, its leftovers; H, table screen; F3, the Atlas; E3, replays

A danger action keeps --danger-text on its Base line (T 2.5), as C2's Remove, C3's Take out of the encounter and End the encounter, and F's Delete do. Settings boxes Sign out every GM browser and a credential's Revoke in a red outline, and its credentials table writes Revoke as a bare red word. The table screen's Revoke this screen and Settings' Release (A 2.4 calls releasing a danger action) are grey ghosts. A menu's delete is hostile red with a cross in the Atlas (Delete pin) and danger text with a bin in replays (Delete replay).

Fix: One danger action everywhere: the label in --danger-text on the Base line; in a menu, a --danger-text row with the bin. Revoke, Release and Delete are danger actions wherever they appear. T plan 4.2's "on a --danger base line" changes to the line the drawings use.

5

Ghost buttons stand in for secondaries

I, settings; I, its leftovers; G, the Compendium; E3, sound; H, table screen; and every dialog foot

The ghost, with no line until hover, is for the quietest action: Cancel or Back beside a Cup (T plan 4.2, A 2.4). It also draws a player row's Actions, Token image and Release, the credentials' Rotate, History and Revoke, the filters' Clear, Clear all and Show all 14, Open the sound board, and the table screen's Open and Revoke this screen. Beside a Cup, Cancel and Back are ghosts in arrival, characters, prep and Settings' dialog, and Base line buttons in the token picker, the chronicle's composer, Settings' phone sheet and the Compendium's editor.

Fix: A ghost only for Cancel or Back beside a Cup, everywhere. Every other secondary sits on its Base line.

6

More than two display titles in a view

D, characters; E, prep; G, the Compendium; F, time and tools

Rule 10 allows one or two display titles in a view. The roster sets every character's name in display capitals, four of them under the bar's PREP. Prep's new encounter heads its two columns in display type (To make it ready, Pick a map) under its own title, as the grid's step (Grid), the Compendium editor's step (Defences) and the calendar's part (Months) do. The character builder heads its step with an eyebrow (CLASS).

Fix: The roster's names in Bai Jamjuree 600, as Prep's encounter cards are. A step's or a column's head is an eyebrow, as the builder's is.

7

The character builder's Steps rail

D, characters (Making a character, Level up)

One Steps rail everywhere (rule 4). Prep and the Compendium draw a done step as a solid cyan box with a dark tick, the current step with a 3 px cyan edge, and a step that needs a choice in an amber box. The builder and Level up draw done as a cyan outline on a cyan tint, the current step with a 2 px horizon edge, and a choice needed in a dashed amber box.

Fix: The builder and Level up take Prep's marks and its cyan edge.

8

Three phone sheets lose the horizon edge

C3, running; C5, log and dice

What opens above carries the horizon on its top edge (theme 1.4). Every dialog, menu, toast and phone sheet does, apart from three phone sheets: a creature's tools (a 2 px cyan edge), and the encounter's options and the dice options (2 px amber edges).

Fix: The horizon on those three sheets, as on the rest.

9

The phone table's switch sits in a well

C2, C3, C4 and C6, C5

A segmented control has no sunken well (T 2.5). On the phone table, C draws its switch (Map, Encounter, Log, Party, Notes) as words on base lines, as Prep's phone switch is. C2, C3, C4 and C5 draw the same switch inside a 1 px box with a dark fill and the chosen segment tinted. The second sweep's wall showed both and passed them.

Fix: Base lines and no well, as C draws it.

10

Two switches

B, arrival; E3, sound and replays; F, the Codex, finding and pages, time and tools; F3; G

DESIGN's switch is a square 46 by 26 track with a cyan glow when on. C2, C3, C5 and Settings draw it (48 by 28 with its edge). Arrival, sound, replays, the Codex, finding and pages, time and tools, the Atlas and the Compendium draw a 38 by 22 track with a dark fill and no glow.

Fix: One switch: the 46 by 26 track with its glow.

11

Picking several: ticks or switches

I, settings

C3 ticks who is in an encounter, and the Compendium ticks its filters and who a record goes to, with 18 to 22 px ticks. Settings picks several from a list with switches: the fourteen scopes, the four ability score methods and the rules assistant's six checks.

Fix: Ticks for picking several from a list; a switch for one setting that is on or off. I 2.4's "the fourteen scopes as switches" changes with it.

12

Icon buttons and a row's More

E3, sound and replays; G, the Compendium; H, table screen; I, settings

An icon button in content sits on a Base line (T 2.5), and a row's More is the dots on it at 36 px, as in Prep, characters, maps, replays, the Codex, the Atlas, time and tools and the Compendium. Sound's library rows and player draw 34 px icons with no line, the Compendium's pane heads a 32 px chevron with no line, the table screen's cards 36 px icons with no line, and replays' eyes 34 px with no line. Settings' player rows say Actions, a ghost word.

Fix: 36 px on the Base line everywhere; a row's More is the dots.

13

Row heights

Menus in C2, C3, E2, F and F3; tables in E2, E3, G and I; phone rows in F, F3, G, H and E3

Rule 8: rows 44 px on a phone, table rows 48 px, compact rows 36 px; A's menu rows are 48 px and its sheet's 52 px. Menu rows are 40 px (the Atlas, the story, maps), 42 px (C2, C3) and 48 px (A, the table screen) on a laptop, and 38 to 53 px on a phone. Table rows are 40 px (the Compendium's table and its sources, the API's fields), 46 px (the Compendium's result lists), 50 and 60 px (tokens), 52 px (Settings' players, sharing) and 54 px (replays). Phone rows under 44 px: the Codex's lists 42, the table screen's turn order 42, the Compendium's sources 40 and filter options 30, replay steps 36, a faction's tiers 40.

Fix: Menu rows 48 px (52 px in a phone sheet), table rows 48 px, phone rows at least 44 px.

14

Base line buttons at 34 px

C, C2, C3, C4 and C6, C5; F, time and tools; D; I

Base line buttons are 36 px on a laptop. The table's panels (C, C2, C3, C4 and C5) and a session's template chips draw them at 34 px, the builder's head and replays' token chips at 38 px, and Settings' Save formula at 40 px.

Fix: 36 px on a laptop with .tap-target, and 44 px on a phone (finding 3). A step's foot keeps its Back as tall as its Cup, as C's values say.

15

Colours outside their meaning

D, characters; F, time and tools; I, its leftovers

Rule 9 gives each colour one meaning. A harmful condition is red on the table (Prone) and amber on the roster (Poisoned). The timeline's entries carry a 3 px magenta edge, which means an Action, homebrew, the stat block's rules, a door or waiting sound. The API reference tags GET in cyan and POST in party blue.

Fix: A condition red, as the table draws it. The timeline's edge --line-raised, cyan when chosen. GET and POST in the dim text colour; DELETE keeps --danger-text.

16

Dates, times and counts

F, finding and pages; G, its pages; I, settings and its leftovers; E3, replays; E2, maps

A date with its time is written five ways: "Oct 12 · 7:02 PM" (version history), "Oct 29 2:08 PM" (a record's history), "Oct 30, 6:05 PM" in VT323 (a credential's history), "Oct 30, 2026, 7:40 PM" (a replay) and "Today at 8:41 PM" (Access). Settings' phone credentials lowercase them ("Last used oct 24 · expires dec 31", "8:41 pm"). On a phone, maps' folder chips count "All maps · 6" at 36 px; every other side list's chips count "All 4" at 44 px.

Fix: "Oct 30, 7:40 PM" and "Today, 8:41 PM", the year only when it isn't this one, in Bai Jamjuree; months, AM and PM with their capitals. Maps' chips read "All maps 6" at 44 px.

17

Empty states without their button

F3, the Atlas; G, the Compendium

An empty state is one line and one secondary button that fixes it (rule 3). The Atlas's empty pin list says "No pins on this map yet. Right-click the map to add one there, or use Add a pin." with Add a pin up in the list's head, and the Compendium home's empty spell lists say "None yet. Make one with New homebrew." with no button.

Fix: "No pins on this map yet." with + Add a pin under it; "No spell lists yet." with + New homebrew under it, a Base line beside the bar's Cup (rule 2).

18

Copy: pronouns, an ellipsis, Done

C3, the GM panel and running; E3, replays; C2; D, characters

The Writing rules name a character and never write "he", "she" or "her": C3 says "stabilizes her" (Lyra), the GM panel "past her speed" (Lyra) and "hit her for 7. She keeps Bless" (Mirena), and a replay step "Dashes after him" (the Goblin Boss). C2's See as a token field shows "Choose…", an ellipsis that opens nothing. Leaving a making flow with its draft kept is Done in the Compendium's editor and the Codex's writing, and Save and close in the character builder.

Fix: "stabilizes Lyra", "past Lyra's speed", "hit Mirena for 7. Mirena keeps Bless", "Dashes after the Goblin Boss"; the field shows "None"; the builder's Save and close becomes Done.

19

The GM ONLY tag

C5, log and dice; I, settings; T rule 7 and 2.2

Rule 7 and T 2.2 put the tag on a page only the GM sees, yet no Prep page, none of Settings' GM sections and no homebrew list carries it. It appears on a GM roll in the log (VT323 14 px, 20 px tall) and on Device's Arrange new encounters row (16 px, 22 px tall). The drawings agree on where it belongs; the rule says more than they do.

Fix: One tag, 16 px in a 22 px box. Rule 7 and T 2.2 say the tag marks what only the GM sees on a surface players also see (a row, a group, a roll); a section only the GM opens carries none.

20

Widths against rule 11

I, settings; F, the Codex

Rule 11: Settings and forms centre at 880 px, and reading text keeps a 680 px measure. Settings' column is 860 px and starts at its side list (I's values say 820 px), and the Codex's reading column is 640 px.

Fix: Settings' column 880 px, beside its side list, and rule 11 says a page with a side list sets its column there; the Codex's measure 680 px.

Also checked, and matching: rolled numbers (the row is the button), sliders and steppers, hidden blocks and their dashed violet tags, scrims (one fill at 58 to 62%%), the horizon on every dialog, menu, toast and the other phone sheets, the Cup's heights against each area's values, the waiting cards, and the verbs for deleting, removing and taking out. The first two sweeps' parts, captured again today, rebuild consistency.html byte for byte, so they still read one way; finding 9 is one thing the second sweep's wall showed and passed.

The Cup

Words only, in its fixed place (T rule 2). Heights follow each area's values: 42 px in a bar or a dialog, 50 px in the table's and builder's feet, 52 and 58 px on arrival.

Base line buttons

A label on a 1 px --line-raised base, 36 px on a laptop (T 2.5). One per area and height.

Ghost buttons

No line until hover: Cancel or Back beside a Cup (T plan 4.2). Amber: a ghost that is another kind of action, or a Cancel or Back beside a Cup drawn on a Base line.

Danger actions

The label in --danger-text on its Base line (T 2.5).

Icon buttons in content and a row's More

An icon on its Base line, 36 px; a row's More is the dots (T 2.5).

Hit areas on a phone

At least 44 px (T 2.5; A's header icons; a sheet's close). One capture per area and kind; the last ones already meet it.
